title: Yosemite: One of America’s Most Famous National Parks (2/2)
titleZh: 優勝美地：美國最著名的國家公園之一 (2/2)
summaryZh: 介紹優勝美地酋長岩的攀岩紀錄，以及攝影家鏡頭下的公園之美。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — America's National Parks

sentences.text: The highest of these is El Capitan, at more than 900 meters.
sentences.zh: 其中最高的是酋長岩，也就是 El Capitan，超過 900 公尺。

sentences.text: And the climb to the top is straight up.
sentences.zh: 而且要爬到頂端是一路垂直向上。

sentences.text: A team first climbed the rock face of El Capitan in 1957. It took them 45 days over 18 months to do it.
sentences.zh: 1957 年，一支隊伍首次攀上酋長岩的岩壁，他們花了 18 個月、總共 45 天才完成。

sentences.text: Today, experienced climbers can do it in about three days.
sentences.zh: 現在，有經驗的攀岩者大約三天就能爬完。

sentences.text: In 2017, American Alex Honnold became the first person to free solo climb El Capitan.
sentences.zh: 2017 年，美國人 Alex Honnold 成為第一個徒手獨攀酋長岩的人。

sentences.text: Free solo is climbing without any ropes or protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 徒手獨攀就是完全不用繩索或防護裝備去攀爬。

sentences.text: Honnold reached the top in less than four hours.
sentences.zh: Honnold 不到四個小時就登頂了。

sentences.text: Photographers and painters also come to Yosemite to try to capture its beauty in their images.
sentences.zh: 攝影師和畫家也會來優勝美地，想把這裡的美留在作品裡。

sentences.text: The most famous Yosemite photographer was American Ansel Adams.
sentences.zh: 拍攝優勝美地最有名的攝影師，是美國人 Ansel Adams。

sentences.text: He took many black and white pictures of the park from the 1920s through the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 從 1920 年代到 1950 年代，他拍下許多這座公園的黑白照片。

sentences.text: Most people who come to Yosemite take pictures.
sentences.zh: 大部分來優勝美地的人都會拍照。

sentences.text: But you do not need them to remember your visit.
sentences.zh: 但你其實不需要靠照片來記住這趟旅程。

sentences.text: Yosemite's extraordinary beauty will be marked in your memory forever.
sentences.zh: 優勝美地那種不凡的美，會永遠留在你的記憶裡。
